order: SHA-256(seed + NUL + family + NUL + sampleId), hexadecimal ascending
statePrecisionAndEvidence: K03/K05: fixed stratified 100 validated output items; each of facts/claims/cognitions/relations/hooks at least 15, or all if fewer; fill remaining places in global hash order. No replacement based on result.
mode: K06: sample 100 applicable fact/claim classification items with the fixed mode salt; types without narration/claim/recollection classification remain not_applicable and do not fill the denominator.
certainty: K07: sample 100 rows actually marked confirmed, using a fixed certainty salt; provisional fraction reported separately. No absent certainty field is treated as confirmed.
factRecall: Review every frozen v1 key fact using the revised vocabulary/entity matching. A gold counted once; preserve subject, predicate/allowed free_predicate semantics, object and effective chapters.
hooks: K08 precision judges every validated output operation, including supported extra hooks. Recall uses distinct matching operations for the frozen gold; do not reuse one bundled operation for multiple gold hooks.
insufficientPopulation: Report available population and any shortage; do not fabricate rows or invoke another paid development batch.
